Container.Name: simplex-bridge
Container.Overview: SimpleX Chat bot daemon — bridge for Hermes Agent and messaging bots
Container.Description:
SimpleX Chat is a fully private, decentralised messaging network that assigns no persistent user IDs. Every contact is an opaque key — even the server cannot determine who is talking to whom.
This container runs a SimpleX Chat bot daemon that provides a WebSocket API for Hermes Agent or any custom bot framework to send and receive messages. Pair it with Hermes Agent for an AI-powered private messenger.
On first run it automatically creates a bot profile and connection address. The bot address is saved to /data/bot_address.txt — share this address with contacts to let them message your bot.
The daemon binds to 127.0.0.1 only. By default, set network type to "Host" for Hermes Agent to connect via localhost. Alternatively, set SIMPLEX_SOCAT_PORT to a port OTHER than 5225 (e.g. 5226) to expose the WebSocket externally via socat bridge — then switch to standard bridge networking and publish that port. Note: the WebSocket API has no authentication; only expose it on trusted networks. See README "Network Configuration" for details.
Compatible with Hermes Agent's built-in SimpleX Chat plugin (no code changes needed — enable via SIMPLEX_WS_URL env var).
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: messaging private e2e encrypted decentralized chat simplex bot hermes ai agent SMP

Config.Name: SIMPLEX_DISPLAY_NAME
Config.Description: Display name shown to contacts when they connect to this bot

Config.Name: SIMPLEX_AUTO_ACCEPT
Config.Description: Auto-accept incoming contact requests (set false to require manual approval)

Config.Name: SIMPLEX_SOCAT_PORT
Config.Description: Optional socat bridge port — MUST be other than 5225 (e.g. 5226); exposes WebSocket on all interfaces. Leave empty for host networking only (127.0.0.1). Unauthenticated: trusted networks only.

Config.Name: SIMPLEX_FILES_ENABLED
Config.Description: Allow file transfers from contacts to the bot

Config.Name: SIMPLEX_TOR
Config.Description: Route messaging connections through Tor SOCKS5 proxy (requires Tor running on host)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions (Unraid default: 99)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions (Unraid default: 100)

Config.Name: Port 5225
Config.Description: SimpleX WebSocket API — informational only under default host networking (port mapping is a no-op); only used when bridge networking + SIMPLEX_SOCAT_PORT are configured

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent data: chat database, connection keys, bot address, attachments
